_comment: break: 0 is deliberate: the nightly mutation job treats a score as a report to look at, never a gate. Added 2026-09-20 to close the 'only 2 of 8 src projects have mutation coverage' gap (docs/handoffs/2026-09-20-coverage-mutation-gaps-from-jaunty-probe.md). Extrode.JauntyQ.Schema has no dedicated test project, but Extrode.JauntyQ.Schema.Extraction.Tests (this project) has a direct, non-aliased ProjectReference to it -- 263 tests resolve against Schema.csproj from here alone (verified 2026-09-20), so no --test-project/extra-test-project flag is needed, unlike jaunty's UnitTests/Tests split. (An earlier version of this comment claimed Extrode.JauntyQ.Generator.Tests also exercises Schema and needed to be added via --test-project; that was wrong -- Generator compile-includes Schema's sources into its own assembly, so its ordinary tests exercise that embedded copy, not the real mutated Schema.dll; only its two extern-alias live-round-trip tests touch the real assembly, and those don't need wiring in here.) Named stryker-config.schema.json, not the bare stryker-config.json, because that name is already Schema.Extraction's own config in this same directory -- invoked via `dotnet stryker --config-file stryker-config.schema.json`.
